## Company Overview

The Arnhem Group was formed in 1980 manufacturing flavor enhancers and functional proteins for the
meat & poultry industries. The industry base has since expanded to the beverage, baking, dairy,
supplement & confectionery industries.

Arnhem expanded its business in 2000, with the introduction of our Oh! So Sweet product line of
all-natural citrus extracts, which contribute zero calories & zero carbohydrates in finished
products. Oh So Sweet works synergistically with sweeteners, allowing food manufactures to reduce
sugar levels by as much as 50% while preserving clean labeling.

In 2008 Arnhem introduced Oh! So Sweet Reb-A/Citrus Extract blend. The new product incorporates
Reb-A (97% min. pure) with our citrus extract. The Oh! So Sweet Reb-A/Citrus Extract blend is all
natural and 1000 times sweeter than sugar.

Our corporate office is based in New Jersey, a short distance from the ports of New York and
Philadelphia, while our warehouses are located in New Jersey and New York.

We continue to strive to provide innovative solutions across the food and beverage industries, and
are always interested in expanding our product base.

# [LEARN ABOUT THE AMERICAN FILM INSTITUTE][126]

[][127]
[][128]
[][129]

The American Film Institute (AFI) is a nonprofit organization with a mandate to champion the moving
image as an art form. Established in 1967, AFI launched the first comprehensive history of American
film and sparked the movement for film preservation in the United States. In addition to the
acclaimed graduate-level film school [AFI Conservatory][130], AFI’s enduring traditions include the
[AFI Life Achievement Award][131], [AFI AWARDS][132], [AFI FEST][133], the [AFI Silver Theatre and
Cultural Center][134] in Maryland, [AFI DWW+][135], [AFI Cinematography Intensive Workshop][136],
the [AFI Catalog of Feature Films][137] and the [AFI Archive][138].

AFI relies on the generous financial support from film enthusiasts like you to provide funding for
its programs and initiatives. Read AFI’s [Impact Report][139].

Thank you for your support.

## SIGN UP FOR OUR NEWSLETTER

The American Film Institute champions the future of the moving image as an art form. We believe in
the revolutionary power of visual storytelling to share diverse perspectives, inspire empathy and
drive culture forward.

We are dedicated to celebrating excellence in the art form and to creating national education
initiatives that inspire artists and audiences alike.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

  ## Creating resources with a circular economy
  
  We can only design sustainable solutions for the future if we think ideas through to the end. For
  us, this is routine. We focus on innovative, efficient cycles every day, from research and
  development to raw materials purchasing to production – and if that's not possible, we try to
  recover all valuable materials to give them a second life. This allows us to manufacture products
  with the smallest possible environmental footprint so we can enrich the lives of millions of
  consumers worldwide.

quality control measures and collaboration with trusted suppliers who share their commitment to

## Company Overview

The Arnhem Group was formed in 1980 manufacturing flavor enhancers and functional proteins for the
meat & poultry industries. The industry base has since expanded to the beverage, baking, dairy,
supplement & confectionery industries.

Arnhem expanded its business in 2000, with the introduction of our Oh! So Sweet product line of
all-natural citrus extracts, which contribute zero calories & zero carbohydrates in finished
products. Oh So Sweet works synergistically with sweeteners, allowing food manufactures to reduce
sugar levels by as much as 50% while preserving clean labeling.

In 2008 Arnhem introduced Oh! So Sweet Reb-A/Citrus Extract blend. The new product incorporates
Reb-A (97% min. pure) with our citrus extract. The Oh! So Sweet Reb-A/Citrus Extract blend is all
natural and 1000 times sweeter than sugar.

Our corporate office is based in New Jersey, a short distance from the ports of New York and
Philadelphia, while our warehouses are located in New Jersey and New York.

We continue to strive to provide innovative solutions across the food and beverage industries, and
are always interested in expanding our product base.

## Company Overview

The Arnhem Group was formed in 1980 manufacturing flavor enhancers and functional proteins for the
meat & poultry industries. The industry base has since expanded to the beverage, baking, dairy,
supplement & confectionery industries.

Arnhem expanded its business in 2000, with the introduction of our Oh! So Sweet product line of
all-natural citrus extracts, which contribute zero calories & zero carbohydrates in finished
products. Oh So Sweet works synergistically with sweeteners, allowing food manufactures to reduce
sugar levels by as much as 50% while preserving clean labeling.

In 2008 Arnhem introduced Oh! So Sweet Reb-A/Citrus Extract blend. The new product incorporates
Reb-A (97% min. pure) with our citrus extract. The Oh! So Sweet Reb-A/Citrus Extract blend is all
natural and 1000 times sweeter than sugar.

Our corporate office is based in New Jersey, a short distance from the ports of New York and
Philadelphia, while our warehouses are located in New Jersey and New York.

We continue to strive to provide innovative solutions across the food and beverage industries, and
are always interested in expanding our product base.

**BIOWAY Industrial Group LTD** is a vertically integrated botanical extract company, headquartered
in Hong Kong. We cultivate 1,500 acres of organic vegetables on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and
operate a 50,000+ square meter modern production facility in Shaanxi Province. Our dedicated R&D
team, with over 15 years of industry experience, ensures the highest quality organic botanical
extracts. Through our international trading company, BIOWAY (Xi’an) Organic Ingredients Co., Ltd.,
we provide sustainable and traceable solutions to global customers.

## 100 Hectares Organic Vegetable Planting Base

We have a 100 hectares organic vegetable planting base in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau region, ensuring
the quality and supply of organic vegetable powder raw materials and meeting the market’s demand for
organic products.

much-needed range of products, including organic spinach, kale, beetroot, broccoli, wheatgrass,
alfalfa, and oat grass powders. These nutrient-dense, plant-based powders are perfect for food
manufacturers, supplement companies, and health-conscious consumers seeking premium, organic
ingredients.

# Bringing Nature to Your Innovations

Consumers today expect more than just quality products. They seek authenticity and sustainability
from the brands they trust. They expect companies to go beyond and deliver solutions that are
natural, effective, and better for the world.

We harness the purity of nature to create solutions and inspire innovation rooted in nature.
Specializing in the niche field of authentic botanical profiles, our portfolio is renowned for
reflecting the pure scents of Nature.

## Essential Oils

[Discover more][10]

Specialized range of pure and tailor-made essential oils, meticulously sourced and manufactured to
deliver a distinctive aromatic profile and characteristics and empower new product innovation.

## Botanical Extracts

[Discover more][11]

Tailored for the perfumery industry and derived using state-of-the-art Liquid CO2 extraction
technology, which preserves the delicate aromatic molecules and ensure the highest potency in each
formulation.

### What Makes Us
### Different

#### Sourcing globally

By partnering with farmers around the globe, we obtain the best quality products and ensure
consistent supply.

#### Innovation

Large professional know-how of natural extractions. Advanced techniques for tailor made products.

#### Regulatory

Regulatory assistance and documentation to ensure product safety. Compliance within the legal frames
of the different international markets.

#### Trains on Time

Our teams thrive to make sure our customers are satisfied and get the product they need, when they
need it.

[Discover Why Partner With Us][12]
Explore our blog to stay.
Discover expert insight and fresh update
[Explore][13]

## Our Key Markets

For over a century, we´ve harnessed the power of nature and science to offer exquisite essential
oils and botanical extracts for the leading companies around the globe. Our commitment to quality,
purity and innovation, with nature always central to our thinking, ensures that your future
creations stand out in a competitive marketplace.

### Fragrances
### & Flavors

Our essential oils and botanical extracts unlock the true soul of botanicals, bringing depth and
distinction to fragrance and flavor formulations. Whether capturing the delicate aromatic molecule
or manufacturing tailor made solutions, our portfolio set a new standard for purity and sensory
impact. Through advanced extraction technology and responsible sourcing, we provide you with the
perfect palette to innovate.

### Beauty & Personal Care,
### Aromatherapy

In beauty, wellness, and self-care, purity and performance go hand in hand – and that´s where our
botanicals excel. Our essential oils and botanical extracts are designed for brands that value clean
beauty and true-to-nature olfactory experience. With cutting-edge extraction methods and unwavering
commitment to natural solutions, we help you create products that feel as good as they do good.

Our deep expertise, premium quality and technical know-how help you create **products that inspire
and endure**.

# FOod additive


Food additives are the chemicals or the substances added to the food products in order to keep them
fresh and to provide enhancement to their texture and flavour. They are added only to the food items
that are not included in the GRAS (generally recognized as Safe) list. This GRAS list includes the
names of only those items which have been in use for long and have not shown any adverse signs. Food
items like salt, sugar and flour have been included in this list. Sellers also need prior Government
approval for adding Food additives in their products.

Food additives include flavour enhancers, preservatives and a variety of food colouring products
like cochineal. They are safe, as only the additives which are found to be safe and having no
adverse effect are approved by the Government. In most cases, food additives mentioned on the label
are included in the other ingredients section. While sometimes their names are clearly mentioned
while at number of times they are also mentioned with their codes. It is important to add food
additives, to some food items so as to maintain the safety of the product through its journey from
factories to warehouse and throughout the process of its transportation to finally making it
available to the end users.

# FOod additive


Food additives are the chemicals or the substances added to the food products in order to keep them
fresh and to provide enhancement to their texture and flavour. They are added only to the food items
that are not included in the GRAS (generally recognized as Safe) list. This GRAS list includes the
names of only those items which have been in use for long and have not shown any adverse signs. Food
items like salt, sugar and flour have been included in this list. Sellers also need prior Government
approval for adding Food additives in their products.

Food additives include flavour enhancers, preservatives and a variety of food colouring products
like cochineal. They are safe, as only the additives which are found to be safe and having no
adverse effect are approved by the Government. In most cases, food additives mentioned on the label
are included in the other ingredients section. While sometimes their names are clearly mentioned
while at number of times they are also mentioned with their codes. It is important to add food
additives, to some food items so as to maintain the safety of the product through its journey from
factories to warehouse and throughout the process of its transportation to finally making it
available to the end users.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

## Yeast Extract

Our yeast extract products are flavors and flavor enhancers. Through our carefully controlled
manufacturing processes, various components have been extracted from the yeast creating unique
flavors that other seasonings and protein hydrolysates don't contain. Our yeast extracts can be used
in sauces, soups, marinades, seasonings, entrees and more.

into “delicious” in any language. You won’t have to travel halfway around the world to find the
perfect savory flavor. We'll bring the world of flavors to you.

bases that are able to building blocks for our savory flavors. By creating our own bases from

About Graveyard Keeper

[Graveyard Keeper][77] is the most inaccurate medieval cemetery management sim of the year. Build &
manage your own graveyard while finding shortcuts to cut costs, expand into entertainment with
witch-burning festivals, and scare nearby villagers into attending church. This is a game of
capitalism and doing whatever it takes to build a thriving business. **Graveyard Keeper** was
created by Lazy Bear Games and published by tinyBuild.

About Us

Henan Hongze Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. is located in Puyang City, Henan
Province, which has a long history and convenient transportation. Since its inception, adhering to
the "friendship in good faith, profit and win-win" business philosophy, to provide customers with
quality products, perfect service as the goal, over the years, continuous innovation and
exploration, out of a high-efficiency microelectrolysis iron carbon filler, multi-substrate ozone
catalyst, high-efficiency manufacturing of activated carbon as the main, a variety of water
treatment materials, production and marketing, engineering and construction, Technical consulting
comprehensive development of the new pattern! The company has one high-temperature pusher kiln, one
activated carbon vertical furnace, one shuttle kiln, and several other equipments, which can meet
the processing, customization, and special parameter production requirements of different customers
for different products. The company is constantly and actively research and development of new and
better products, has and Suzhou University, Hubei University, Zhengzhou University, Beijing
Agricultural University and some other colleges and universities to carry out good technical and
business cooperation, product sales throughout the country, exported to South Korea, Southeast Asia,
Japan, Europe and the United States, and other countries, and achieved good results in the
application. We will continue to work hard to forge ahead and actively innovate to achieve greater
results. Since the establishment of the company has been adhering to the "integrity, exquisite,
scientific, innovative" concept. We warmly welcome friends from all walks of life to visit and guide
our company, and work together for common development!

of modern food production. Our encapsulated series includes[** innovative solutions like
encapsulated malic acid and fumaric acid, **][46]designed for controlled release and enhanced
stability in various applications. We also offer[** hydrophilic colloids, essential **][47]for
improving the texture and consistency of food products, ensuring they meet the highest standards of
quality.

For those seeking natural solutions, our **clean label ingredients** provide transparency and
simplicity, catering to the growing demand for natural and minimally processed foods. Additionally,
our health ingredients are crafted to boost the nutritional profile of your products, supporting
overall wellness and health benefits. To ensure longevity and safety, our range of preservatives
includes natural and effective options that extend the shelf life of your food products without
compromising on quality. Choose Megafood for all your food additive needs, where quality and
innovation meet to enhance your culinary creations.

# [LEARN ABOUT THE AMERICAN FILM INSTITUTE][126]

[][127]
[][128]
[][129]

The American Film Institute (AFI) is a nonprofit organization with a mandate to champion the moving
image as an art form. Established in 1967, AFI launched the first comprehensive history of American
film and sparked the movement for film preservation in the United States. In addition to the
acclaimed graduate-level film school [AFI Conservatory][130], AFI’s enduring traditions include the
[AFI Life Achievement Award][131], [AFI AWARDS][132], [AFI FEST][133], the [AFI Silver Theatre and
Cultural Center][134] in Maryland, [AFI DWW+][135], [AFI Cinematography Intensive Workshop][136],
the [AFI Catalog of Feature Films][137] and the [AFI Archive][138].

AFI relies on the generous financial support from film enthusiasts like you to provide funding for
its programs and initiatives. Read AFI’s [Impact Report][139].

Thank you for your support.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Sensient Technologies

Sensient Technologies Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors,
and other specialty ingredients. Sensient uses advanced technologies and robust global supply chain
capabilities to develop specialized solutions for food and beverages, as well as products that serve
the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic, and personal care industries.

Sweetner prides itself on a record of excellent services.  Our main goal is complete customer

*We are dedicated to being*

**We stock hundreds of products for your convenience.**

Bell Chem is a diversified ingredient distributor based in Longwood, FL (just north of Orlando). We
provide next day delivery service to most of Florida, FTL and LTL shipping across the continental
United States, and delivery to your preferred Florida port for international shipping. Explore our
website to discover more about our company, product range, mission, and how we can become *your
simple source*.

**BIOWAY Industrial Group LTD** is a vertically integrated botanical extract company, headquartered
in Hong Kong. We cultivate 1,500 acres of organic vegetables on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and
operate a 50,000+ square meter modern production facility in Shaanxi Province. Our dedicated R&D
team, with over 15 years of industry experience, ensures the highest quality organic botanical
extracts. Through our international trading company, BIOWAY (Xi’an) Organic Ingredients Co., Ltd.,
we provide sustainable and traceable solutions to global customers.

## 100 Hectares Organic Vegetable Planting Base

We have a 100 hectares organic vegetable planting base in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau region, ensuring
the quality and supply of organic vegetable powder raw materials and meeting the market’s demand for
organic products.
By partnering with exclusive organic farms and processing facilities, we are bringing to market a
much-needed range of products, including organic spinach, kale, beetroot, broccoli, wheatgrass,
alfalfa, and oat grass powders. These nutrient-dense, plant-based powders are perfect for food
manufacturers, supplement companies, and health-conscious consumers seeking premium, organic
ingredients.

acid esters, dibasic acid esters, etc.; phosphate ester flame retardant plasticizers; lubricating
oil and grease materials, etc., which are mainly used in plastics and coatings as environmentally
friendly plasticizers, film-forming agents, lubricants and solvents.

Consumers today expect more than just quality products. They seek authenticity and sustainability
from the brands they trust. They expect companies to go beyond and deliver solutions that are
natural, effective, and better for the world.

reflecting the pure scents of Nature.

deliver a distinctive aromatic profile and characteristics and empower new product innovation.

creations stand out in a competitive marketplace.

### Fragrances
### & Flavors

perfect palette to innovate.

### Beauty & Personal Care,
### Aromatherapy

botanicals excel. Our essential oils and botanical extracts are designed for brands that value clean
beauty and true-to-nature olfactory experience. With cutting-edge extraction methods and unwavering
commitment to natural solutions, we help you create products that feel as good as they do good.

Our deep expertise, premium quality and technical know-how help you create **products that inspire
and endure**.

# FOod additive


Food additives are the chemicals or the substances added to the food products in order to keep them
fresh and to provide enhancement to their texture and flavour. They are added only to the food items
that are not included in the GRAS (generally recognized as Safe) list. This GRAS list includes the
names of only those items which have been in use for long and have not shown any adverse signs. Food
items like salt, sugar and flour have been included in this list. Sellers also need prior Government
approval for adding Food additives in their products.

Food additives include flavour enhancers, preservatives and a variety of food colouring products
like cochineal. They are safe, as only the additives which are found to be safe and having no
adverse effect are approved by the Government. In most cases, food additives mentioned on the label
are included in the other ingredients section. While sometimes their names are clearly mentioned
while at number of times they are also mentioned with their codes. It is important to add food
additives, to some food items so as to maintain the safety of the product through its journey from
factories to warehouse and throughout the process of its transportation to finally making it
available to the end users.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

## Yeast Extract

Our yeast extract products are flavors and flavor enhancers. Through our carefully controlled
manufacturing processes, various components have been extracted from the yeast creating unique
flavors that other seasonings and protein hydrolysates don't contain. Our yeast extracts can be used
in sauces, soups, marinades, seasonings, entrees and more.

About Graveyard Keeper

[Graveyard Keeper][77] is the most inaccurate medieval cemetery management sim of the year. Build &
manage your own graveyard while finding shortcuts to cut costs, expand into entertainment with
witch-burning festivals, and scare nearby villagers into attending church. This is a game of
capitalism and doing whatever it takes to build a thriving business. **Graveyard Keeper** was
created by Lazy Bear Games and published by tinyBuild.

About Us

Henan Hongze Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. is located in Puyang City, Henan
Province, which has a long history and convenient transportation. Since its inception, adhering to
the "friendship in good faith, profit and win-win" business philosophy, to provide customers with
quality products, perfect service as the goal, over the years, continuous innovation and
exploration, out of a high-efficiency microelectrolysis iron carbon filler, multi-substrate ozone
catalyst, high-efficiency manufacturing of activated carbon as the main, a variety of water
treatment materials, production and marketing, engineering and construction, Technical consulting
comprehensive development of the new pattern! The company has one high-temperature pusher kiln, one
activated carbon vertical furnace, one shuttle kiln, and several other equipments, which can meet
the processing, customization, and special parameter production requirements of different customers
for different products. The company is constantly and actively research and development of new and
better products, has and Suzhou University, Hubei University, Zhengzhou University, Beijing
Agricultural University and some other colleges and universities to carry out good technical and
business cooperation, product sales throughout the country, exported to South Korea, Southeast Asia,
Japan, Europe and the United States, and other countries, and achieved good results in the
application. We will continue to work hard to forge ahead and actively innovate to achieve greater
results. Since the establishment of the company has been adhering to the "integrity, exquisite,
scientific, innovative" concept. We warmly welcome friends from all walks of life to visit and guide
our company, and work together for common development!
